task.title: Strength Build62 diagnosis: decisive new evidence, root-cause candidates found, deterministic Native observability prepared (not shipped)

result.summary: Continued the Build62 Strength diagnosis (Step 2 of the standing ChatGPT sequencing) now that Cardio/V3 (see related report) is complete. A bounded, all-time, zero-write server audit proved workout-reconciliation.resolve.v1 has NEVER produced a single command_receipts row for this account, while every other command type flowed normally through the same period -- ruling out ordinary transport/auth flakiness as the mechanism (explains why two independent, independently-reviewed retry fixes both failed real acceptance). Precise ID-based inspection also found the pending review's identity has churned: the actual current pending review (localDate 2026-09-24, 60% match, matches the Founder's screenshot) was only created by an ingestion-reassessment batch on 2026-09-26, two days after the workout; a separate, adjacent-date review was auto-confirmed by a system matcher, not the Founder. A static read of the real Build62 Native source surfaced two concrete architectural weaknesses that would be indistinguishable from server telemetry alone: a silent early-return guard with no error surfaced, and a blanket error-catch that discards whether a failure was a genuine connection failure, a task cancellation, a timeout, or something else. Per the explicit instruction not to ship another speculative retry, deterministic Native observability was designed, implemented, tested, and fresh-context reviewed (two rounds) instead -- ready as a candidate for the future batched Native build, not archived or uploaded.

tests.summary: Whole app target builds clean. Scoped test run of new diagnostic-type tests plus the complete pre-existing FounderServerAPITests suite: 212/212 passing, zero failures, including all four pre-existing WorkoutReconciliation* API-layer tests -- confirms the perform() instrumentation is purely additive.

review.summary: Two rounds of fresh-context adversarial review. First round approved the instrumentation as safe (verified: no control-flow/retry/thrown-type change, actor-isolation correctness, no PII/token leak, correct pbxproj wiring) with two moderate follow-ups (3 sibling silent guards untouched; no test proved the real perform() catch line fires) and two low-severity notes. Both moderate follow-ups fixed in a second commit and reverified: 212/212 passing after fixes.

zero_write_audit.summary: Bounded, zero-write, rolled-back production audit searched command_receipts across the account's ENTIRE history (not a narrow window) for the exact command type: zero rows, ever. Cross-checked against 4 days of all-other-command-type activity (276 HealthKit ingestion batches, training-session commits, check-ins, priority completions), all committed normally in the same window. Also read the exact evidence-review records by precise ID (not substring match) to establish the review-identity-churn finding.

decisions_required: None blocking. For awareness: the diagnostic instrumentation prepared here should be included in the next coherent batched Native candidate (items A-H); the Founder's next real Strength confirmation attempt against that build will be the first with genuine Native-side diagnostic evidence (readable via a new in-app 'Workout Reconciliation Diagnostics' screen) rather than requiring more server-side forensic guesswork.
unexpected_findings: The pending Strength reconciliation review's identity has churned: the record the Founder has been attempting to confirm (localDate 2026-09-24, matches the Founder's screenshot) was recreated by an ingestion-reassessment batch on 2026-09-26, two days after the underlying workout -- a distinct, adjacent-date review (localDate 2026-09-23) was separately auto-confirmed by a system matcher, not by the Founder.

workout-reconciliation.resolve.v1 has zero command_receipts rows across the account's entire history -- not just around the recent failures -- while every other command type flows normally, decisively ruling out generic transport/auth flakiness as the shared mechanism behind both prior fix attempts' failures.

recommended_next_step: Fold this diagnosis and its prepared instrumentation into the single coherent next Native candidate batching items A-H, under its own separate authorization. Do not ask the Founder to retry the Sep24/Sep26 Strength confirmation again until that instrumented build is in hand.
